evaluation_audit.interpretation: config lpips_status is initial configuration value; per-output rows and config lpips_status_counts report actual evaluation outcome. Investigate output rows and error fields rather than initial setting.

scope: Post-hoc R86 pilot, 10 selected existing R85 sources, one seed, 10 reused anchors plus 40 newly generated. Six endpoints; two primary contrasts. CIs pointwise; Holm families selected post hoc. No inference about independent test/general population.

methods.ci: Reproduction of archive: Python random.Random(86001), 10000 source bootstraps; sequential comparison and endpoint order; sorted order statistics [250] and [9749].
methods.p_exact: Two-sided exhaustive 2^n source sign flips; |sum| at least observed with absolute tolerance 1e-12; no Monte Carlo.
methods.holm: Two primary contrasts per endpoint; sensitivity family is 2 contrasts x 6 endpoints = 12 tests across endpoints, all post hoc.
methods.localization: L means and per-case contrasts recomputed from exported L CSV; masks not in compact export so individual values cannot be independently regenerated here.

archived_audit.dose_definition: target RMS before h; applied state update RMS = h * target

metadata.scope: post-hoc diagnostic; official mask not used by inference
metadata.L_definition: area-weighted mean E within official edit mask minus area-weighted mean E outside it; not a pre-existing benchmark metric
metadata.mask: data/<case>/outer.png; grayscale 0..255 converted to [0,1], PIL BOX area downsample to 64x64; mask 1 = edit region
metadata.shift: E_shifted is toroidal 32,32 roll of native E; for GLOBAL E_original is diagnostic of the probe, not an applied global allocation
metadata.R85_anchor: raw float tensor was not archived; marked missing rather than substituting a new run or JPEG
metadata.denominators: inside and outside weighted cell mass; empty region or missing tensor yields missing L
